items.title: 14.8 Air quality (hawa kitni saaf hai) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.8 with Table 14.2, printed pages 314-315.

blocks.text: Air quality (hawa kitni saaf hai) Air Quality Index (AQI) se napi jati hai. AQI kisi khaas jagah ki hawa mein maujood pollutants ki concentration ka measure (napne ka number) hai. Jab air quality achhi ho to hawa saaf hoti hai aur us mein solid particles aur chemical pollutants bohat thore hote hain. Kharab air quality, jis mein pollutants zyada hon, aksar hazy (dhundli) hoti hai aur sehat aur environment ke liye khatarnak hoti hai.

50 se kam AQI achha (good) samjha jata hai; yani sehat ko khatre ke baghair bahar waqt guzarna safe (mehfooz) hai. 300 se zyada AQI hazardous (khatarnak) samjha jata hai. 18 saal se kam bachche, 65 saal se zyada umr ke log, aur dil aur lungs ki chronic (purani) bimariyon wale log high risk (zyada khatre) mein hote hain. Bahar kaam karne wale log lambe exposure ki wajah se aur bhi zyada khatre mein hote hain.

blocks.prompt: AQI 40 wale din aur AQI 320 wale din mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: AQI 40 (50 se kam) achha hai; bahar waqt guzarna safe (mehfooz) hai. AQI 320 (300 se zyada) hazardous hai; khaas kar bachche, buzurg, dil aur lungs ke mareez aur bahar kaam karne wale sab se zyada khatre mein hain aur unhen bahar jane se bachna chahiye.

items: AQI kisi jagah ki hawa mein pollutants ki concentration napta hai: 50 se kam achha, 300 se zyada hazardous.
Bachche, buzurg, dil aur lungs ke mareez aur bahar kaam karne wale sab se zyada khatre mein.
